mods.name: AcaciaCustomContentPatcher
mods.description: BepInEx preloader patcher for Silverpine that removes Acacia-specific custom-content editor restrictions and preserves original personality traits when an override field is blank.

mods.name: Acacia Unlocked
mods.description: Silverpine BepInEx mod that expands Acacia's resident, conversation, movement, and routine behavior after she joins the player.

mods.name: Additional Equipment Slots
mods.description: Adds twenty-two logical equipment slots to Silverpine 1.7.3, integrated with Custom Item Loader 1.8.3 or later.

mods.name: Arrival Meetings
mods.description: Silverpine BepInEx mod for conversation travel, rooms grouped by property owner, and bringing selected or intended NPCs into ongoing multi-NPC conversations. Created by Saelac and ChatGPT.

mods.name: Attribute Expansion
mods.description: An optional companion for Custom Item Loader 2.1.0 on Silverpine 1.7.3. It registers calculation-point equipment modifiers with the Custom Item Editor and patches the corresponding game formulas.

mods.name: BepInEx Folder Warnings
mods.description: Silverpine BepInEx utility that detects plugin DLLs placed in the patchers folder and preloader patchers placed in the plugins folder, then logs corrective warnings.

mods.name: Breaking and Entering
mods.description: BepInEx plugin for Silverpine: radial-menu break-ins, timed door and window entry, witness reactions, and guard reports.

mods.name: Camera Zoom
mods.description: Adjustable 0.2x-2.0x camera zoom for Silverpine with Modding Tools controls and viewport-aware weather overlays.

mods.name: Comfy Image Generator
mods.description: BepInEx image generation for Silverpine through ComfyUI: selectable characters, Illustrious/Anima prompts, visual profiles, LoRAs, caching and detailers. Created by Saelac and ChatGPT.

mods.name: Conversation Observer
mods.description: A BepInEx plugin for Silverpine that adds a Modding Tools conversation action named Step Away whenever at least two NPCs are participating.

mods.name: Conversation Participant Picker
mods.description: Silverpine BepInEx mod that lets the player choose nearby visible NPCs when beginning a conversation, including multi-participant dialogue.

mods.name: Custom Rumors
mods.description: Configurable NPC rumor generation, targeting, and delivery behavior for Silverpine, built as a BepInEx plugin.

mods.name: Custom Crafting Recipes
mods.description: A BepInEx/Harmony plugin for Silverpine 1.7.3 that completes the dormant CustomCrafting workbench with configurable, recipe-based crafting.

mods.name: Custom Enemy Loader
mods.description: CustomEnemyLoader 1.3.12 adds JSON-defined enemies to Silverpine through BepInEx. Enemy packs can reuse a base-game enemy's movement, collision, loot, shadow, and other components while replacing its name, health, behavior, combat abilities, visuals, sounds, and world-generation locations.

mods.name: Custom Growables
mods.description: A BepInEx add-on for Silverpine 1.7.3 and Custom Item Loader 2.7.0. It turns ordinary Custom Item Loader items into plantable, persistent growables by reading an optional growable block from the same item definition.

mods.name: Manual Custom Item Generator
mods.description: OBSOLETE: replaced by SaltExtraDebug v0.26.0 or newer, including the manual item wizard and save-loading support. Retained for historical use.
mods.notes: Replaced by SaltExtraDebug 0.26.0+. Close the game, back up and remove CustomItemFreezeFix.dll from BepInEx/plugins. Existing item data is preserved.

mods.name: Custom Item Loader
mods.description: A runtime BepInEx plugin for Silverpine 1.7.3. It loads custom item packs recursively from:

mods.name: CustomItemPromptPatcher
mods.description: OBSOLETE: replaced by SaltExtraDebug v0.26.0 or newer, including the manual item wizard and save-loading support. Retained for historical use.
mods.notes: Replaced by SaltExtraDebug 0.26.0+. Close the game, back up and remove CustomItemPromptPatcher.dll from BepInEx/patchers. Do not leave the old preloader installed. Existing item data is preserved.

mods.name: Custom NPC Knowledge Variables
mods.description: A small BepInEx side plugin for Silverpine that adds %PLAYER_NAME% support to knowledge authored through the game's built-in custom NPC editor.

mods.name: Custom World Setup
mods.description: Custom World Setup is a BepInEx plugin for Silverpine 1.7.3 that replaces the base game's fixed world layout with a JSON-defined grid. It includes an in-game visual editor, custom road and river masks, automatic bridges, persistent wilderness tiles, and fully buildable tiles.

mods.name: Dialogue Box Controls
mods.description: BepInEx plugin for Silverpine: dialogue box opacity and hide/show controls below the text box, with persistent settings and Modding Tools integration. Created by Saelac and ChatGPT.

mods.name: Dynamic NPC Relationships
mods.description: Save-scoped dynamic NPC-to-NPC relationships for Silverpine, built as a BepInEx plugin.

mods.name: Expanded Important Relationships
mods.description: Raises Silverpine's custom NPC important-relationship limit from two to five.

mods.name: Extended Custom NPC Slots Rumor Fix
mods.description: Companion fix for ExtendedCustomNPCSlots.Patcher.dll on Silverpine 1.7.3.

components.name: Extended Custom NPC Slots Rumor Fix

mods.name: Follow NPC
mods.description: BepInEx mod for Silverpine: NPC-led walking, automatic player following, and dialogue resumption on arrival. Created by Saelac and ChatGPT.

mods.name: InstantDialoguePatcher
mods.description: Rewrites Silverpine's compiled DialogBox.AnimateText coroutine before Assembly-CSharp loads. The game's rich-text and speaker-name preprocessing still runs, but the per-character rendering loop is replaced with full text assignment and the completed text starts on TextMeshPro page 1.

mods.name: Inventory Editor
mods.description: BepInEx plugin for Silverpine: a charcoal inventory editor with item browsing, custom text, durability, spoilage, enchantments, food and water values, gold and carrying capacity. Created by Saelac and ChatGPT.

mods.name: LLM Prompt Logger
mods.description: BepInEx 5 debugging plugin that logs complete Silverpine LLM prompts at generation boundaries.

mods.name: Lua Routine Extensions
mods.description: Lua Routine Extensions adds read-only base-game schedule checks to the Lua environment used by Silverpine custom characters. The functions are registered in the game's own Lua function catalog, so they are also included in the creator-facing Lua documentation and AI routine-generation context.

mods.name: Missing NPC Relationship Save Bypass
mods.description: A BepInEx plugin for Silverpine 1.7.3 that allows a custom NPC definition to be saved when one or more authored relationship targets are not currently installed.

mods.name: Modding Tools Menu
mods.description: Shared menu, UI, serialization, construction, audio, and dialogue framework for Silverpine BepInEx mods. Created by Saelac and ChatGPT.

mods.name: Mod Update Checker
mods.description: Optional BepInEx addon: Check for Updates in Modding Tools using one public version catalog, with obsolete replacements and release links. No startup requests.

mods.name: Monster Dialogue
mods.description: Talk with Silverpine monsters and animals through native neural dialogue, with shared tile memories, editable personalities, portraits, and mixed NPC groups. Created by Saelac and ChatGPT.

mods.name: Multi-NPC Conversation Resume
mods.description: BepInEx plugin that resumes recent multi-NPC conversations in Silverpine, with Modding Tools save support.

mods.name: Named NPC Property
mods.description: BepInEx mod for Silverpine: named and shared NPC property, ownership transfers, keys, local door knocking, and overnight invitations. Created by Saelac and ChatGPT.

mods.name: NovelAI Endpoint
mods.description: Silverpine BepInEx mod that adds NovelAI as a hosted text-generation endpoint, including streaming responses, model selection, request pacing, and encrypted per-provider API-key storage.

mods.name: NPC Relationship Context Optimizer
mods.description: Reduces Silverpine dialogue prompt growth for large custom-NPC rosters while preserving relevant relationship context.

mods.name: NPC Response Multiplier
mods.description: Silverpine BepInEx mod that scales NPC response tokens and verbosity together through Modding Tools. Defaults to 1x.

mods.name: NPC Routine Error Reporter
mods.description: BepInEx plugin for Silverpine that identifies NPC routine and Lua errors, with a searchable Modding Tools report history.

mods.name: Player Character Sprite Scaler
mods.description: Version 1.4.0 is a BepInEx plugin for Silverpine's custom player-character editor. It provides separate X/Y controls for:

mods.name: Player Dialog Art
mods.description: PlayerDialogArt is a BepInEx 5 plugin for Silverpine 1.7.3. It lets the player choose temporary dialog portrait art from the in-game ModTools menu and independently enable or disable the player's LLM-driven expression system.

mods.name: Projectile Transition Fix
mods.description: Silverpine BepInEx fix that safely cancels projectiles whose owner or target is destroyed during transitions and recovers related damage-handling null references.

mods.name: QOLCharSelector
mods.description: Scrollable, searchable player-character selector for Silverpine 1.7.3.

mods.name: QOLNPCSelector
mods.description: Quality-of-life NPC selection and SILC management tools for Silverpine.

mods.name: Revealing
mods.description: A BepInEx addon for Silverpine 1.7.3 and Custom Item Loader 2.2.1. It lets a custom clothing or accessory item define its actual chest/waist coverage and give the LLM a precise author-written description instead of Silverpine's generic topless, pantless, or naked text.

mods.name: Runtime NPC Editor
mods.description: A BepInEx runtime editor for changing loaded NPC descriptions, personality traits, and the destination/activity fields of their existing routines. Version 2 uses native Silverpine button, font, input-field, transition, and scaling templates instead of IMGUI.

mods.name: Salt Dialogue Impersonator
mods.description: A standalone BepInEx plugin for Silverpine that replaces the dialogue debug menu's original Impersonate behavior.

mods.name: Salt Extra Debug
mods.description: A BepInEx 5 plugin for Silverpine that enables the game's debug menu and adds persistent runtime toggles for Free Build.

mods.name: Silverpine Guard System
mods.description: SilverpineGuardSystem is a BepInEx plugin that expands Silverpine's built-in NeuralNPC call_guards function.

mods.name: Silverpine Vertical Layers
mods.description: SilverpineVerticalLayers is a BepInEx plugin for Silverpine 1.7.3 that adds connected, buildable upper floors to the base Silverpine world tile.

mods.name: Starting Inventory
mods.description: BepInEx plugin for Silverpine: configurable new-character inventories and custom template-based starting items, with a main-menu Modding Tools editor. Created by Saelac and ChatGPT.

mods.name: Structure Handler
mods.description: Adds Structure Handler controls to Silverpine's shared in-game Mods menu and a structure editor to the main-menu mod tools.

mods.name: Terrain Construction
mods.description: Adds a Terrains category to the Modding Tools construction window. The category discovers Silverpine's serialized prefab_tile_ resources and makes every visually distinct terrain/floor tile placeable at no material or hammer cost. The redundant Wood Bridge entry is omitted because it looks identi...

mods.name: Toggle Follower
mods.description: Adds Toggle Follower to Silverpine's inventory Actions menu and to the player-action radial wheel opened with U. It is placed at the front of the shared action list so it remains on the wheel's first page.

mods.name: Vendor Inventory Manager
mods.description: Vendor Inventory Manager is a BepInEx plugin for Silverpine 1.7.3. It adds a Modding Tools editor on both the main menu and in-game Mods tab for assigning additional vendor stock to:
